subject: Computer Networks
text: Which OSI layer is responsible for routing packets between networks?
explanation: The Network layer performs logical addressing and routing.

subject: Computer Networks
text: How many usable host addresses are in a typical IPv4 /26 subnet?
explanation: A /26 has 64 addresses; subtract network and broadcast: 62 usable.

subject: Computer Networks
text: Which protocol resolves domain names to IP addresses?
explanation: DNS maps domain names to IP addresses.

subject: Computer Networks
text: Which transport protocol provides reliable, connection-oriented delivery?
explanation: TCP provides reliable ordered byte-stream delivery.

subject: Computer Networks
text: Which protocol protects HTTP traffic with TLS?
explanation: HTTPS is HTTP secured with TLS.

subject: Computer Networks
text: Which OSI layer provides end-to-end transport services to applications?
explanation: The Transport layer provides end-to-end delivery services.

subject: Computer Networks
text: How many bits are used in an IPv6 address?

subject: Computer Networks
text: How many usable host addresses are available in a conventional IPv4 /27 subnet?
explanation: A /27 has 32 addresses; network and broadcast leave 30 usable hosts.

subject: Computer Networks
text: Which protocol automatically leases IP configuration to clients?
explanation: DHCP dynamically supplies IP configuration to hosts.

subject: Computer Networks
text: Which transport protocol is connectionless and does not guarantee delivery?
explanation: UDP is connectionless and does not provide delivery guarantees.

subject: Computer Networks
text: Which mechanism can authenticate a message and verify its integrity using a secret key?
explanation: HMAC provides keyed message authentication and integrity.
